sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

Although no data are available on the use of simethicone during breastfeeding, it is not absorbed orally. Therefore, it cannot be transferred to breastmilk. It is also used safely given directly to infants. No special precautions are required.
